note: Observed client demand. Quotes verbatim from the cited pages; poster claims are claims, not facts. Reddit was blocked on every route on 2026-10-12.

issues.title: Card declined or blocked on a routine purchase (false fraud flag)
issues.frequencyEvidence: Very common. Nine separate Trustpilot reviews in 2026 alone; appears in every month sampled.

quotes.text: "Declined my card for a $60 pizza purchase. 5 hour wait to figure out why." (Aug 16, 2026)
"they flagged it as fraud suspicion and blocked my card" (Jun 26, 2026; paying a locksmith to get back into their own home)
"My CC has been blocked 3 days in a row" (Mar 26, 2026)
"to have a transaction unblocked/unflagged, so it could go through." (Jul 5, 2026; Visa refused for online use, no supervisor offered)

issues.underlyingJob: Complete an ordinary purchase right now, often time-critical (food, locksmith, contractor).
issues.emotion: angry, embarrassed at the counter, then exhausted by the wait.
issues.resolutionSeen: Mostly unresolved in the post; several say they are closing the account. Made worse: long hold times (five hours cited), being told to wait until the next day and visit a branch in another town, a rep ending the call when asked why.
issues.posterClaims: that RBC blocks repeat purchases at the same merchant on consecutive days; that a $40k daily limit was in place yet a $1,200 transaction was still blocked ("RBC will not allow other transactions for said amount through their visa even with over 40k daily limit", Feb 1, 2026, https://ca.trustpilot.com/review/www.rbc.com?page=2).
issues.source: Trustpilot, creditcardGenius, smartcustomer.com, news archives; Reddit unreachable. See research/observed-demand.md

quotes.text: "The bank locked my business account because they deemed my OWN credit card payment as ‘fraudulent’." (Oct 10, 2026)
"multiple "account restrictions" placed on the account and can neither pay a contractor" (Jul 24, 2026)
"RBC just blocked two e-transfer in three days." (Jul 21, 2026; account locked pending a password reset the client refused)

issues.title: Unauthorized charges on credit or debit; refund slow, partial or refused
issues.frequencyEvidence: Very common. OBSI: fraud is one-third of all banking cases (2025).

quotes.text: "their Fraud department told me that there was no fraud" (Jun 26, 2026; payment via a processor to a scam organisation; felt blamed)
"I got a fraudulent transaction on my debit card EVEN AFTER LOCKING my card" (Oct 2, 2026)
"they couldn't place a stop payment or even issue a new card right away." (Apr 10, 2026; account locked, three-week investigation, no refund promised)
"Lost $1,600 to a fraudster and the bank was not willing to find out the reason" (Aug 30, 2024)

issues.underlyingJob: Get the money back and stop further loss.
issues.emotion: scared, then angry at being treated as the suspect.
issues.resolutionSeen: Mixed: one reviewer got funds back after "7 business days" ("allowing money to be removed from my account without consent and then I have to wait 7 business days", Aug 4, 2026, https://ca.trustpilot.com/review/www.rbcroyalbank.com?page=3); others report nothing after weeks. Made worse: no provisional credit, no stop-payment, no immediate replacement card, being told the fraud was "the customer's".
issues.posterClaims: that a card lock does not stop fraudulent debits (RBC's own page says locks block purchases, cash advances and withdrawals but allow pre-authorized payments and refunds, https://www.rbcroyalbank.com/credit-cards/cardholders/lost-or-stolen-credit-card.html); that RBC holds the client liable if not reported within 30 days of the statement (RBC Caribbean FAQ wording surfaced in search).

issues.frequencyEvidence: Common. OBSI: chargeback complaints "increased substantially" in 2025.

quotes.text: "I reported to RCBC credit card and they never paid for my loss" (Sep 24, 2026; online purchase never delivered, cancelling card)

"Tried to contact with RBC dispute department regarding disputed transaction but the person don't listen me" (Feb 15, 2026; call cut off)

Positive counter-example: "handling my Credit Card Dispute case so professionally and swiftly." (Jul 30, 2026; $4,000 non-delivery, credit restored in about five business days on the date the agent promised)

issues.underlyingJob: Get money back from a merchant who did not deliver.
issues.resolutionSeen: Ranges from five-day credit to "never paid". What made it better: the agent gave a specific date and met it. What made it worse: no written reasons, calls ending mid-explanation.
issues.verifiedContext: contact the merchant first and "give the merchant or service provider 15-20 business days to issue a credit prior to contacting RBC"; dispute requests can be started in Online Banking; temporary credit "usually within about two business days"; a request with no reply after 10 business days is treated as closed. https://www.RBCroyalbank.com/credit-cards/cardholders/credit-card-transaction-help.html
